headline: I Am The Geologist Who Accidentally Traded Iran’s Natural Gas Find For A Used Scooter On OLX
body:
Look, I am a simple man of science, not a commodities broker. When the Ministry of Petroleum and Energy called to ask if I had cataloged the 200 billion cubic metres of natural gas recently discovered in the South Pars field, I panicked. I was in the middle of a chaotic move to a new apartment in Tehran, and I had listed my old 2012 Bajaj scooter on an online marketplace to cover my security deposit. I accidentally sent the site’s automated 'item description' template to the Minister's personal WhatsApp instead of the engine specs.

I didn't even realize the mistake until I got a notification that my listing for 'Clean-burning high-pressure energy resource, slightly used, negotiable for quick sale' had received a formal bid from a diplomatic attaché in a black sedan. I was so overwhelmed by the sheer volume of gas, I just clicked 'Accept' because I saw the phrase 'Immediate Possession' and assumed it meant the buyer would finally come pick up my rusted scooter.

Now the National Gas Company is calling my cell phone every six minutes, and I am currently hiding in the storage room of a local falafel shop. I tried to explain to the regional director that I thought I was just liquidating assets for a down payment, but he keeps shouting something about 'sovereign wealth reserves' and 'international trade violations.' If anyone finds me, please tell my wife that the scooter, at least, was worth the trouble.
caption: When you accidentally sell the nation's energy reserves to an anonymous buyer on a local classifieds app. #Iran #GasFind #OLXLife #GeologyOops (satire)
